summary: The proof is complete and correctly scoped. For each good parity class, summing the unordered off-diagonal reservoir weights gives Q_xi = (A_xi^2 - sum a_z^2)/(8A_xi) <= A_xi/8, while bad classes contribute zero, so Q(C) <= W(C)/8. The displayed positive-volume integer fibers of the n=2 body include the vertices of its nondegenerate lattice polygon, hence their affine hull is R^2 and accepted fact 8aac56c49321466c applies with q=2, W_A=W, and alpha_2=1/64. For the n=3 body, the convex hull is exactly the product of the translated two-dimensional construction with the height interval [0,2]; consequently its positive integer fibers are precisely D times {0,1,2}, with equal volume b_u on all three height layers. The height-one slice has intrinsic rank two, mass W/3, and is proper, so equation (15) of 8aac56c49321466c yields min{65W/192,W/96}=W/96. The reservoir bound then gives W/64 >= Q/8 and W/96 >= Q/12. Nonnegativity of the canonical augmentation handles Q=0, while Q>0 contradicts the hard inequality by the displayed stronger bounds. None of these canonical body quantities depends on the arbitrary legal matching weights, so the final independence and scope qualifications are valid.
